parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of the instance. You can use this description to filter instances. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: edition
parameters.description: The instance type. Valid values: vector: OpenSearch Vector Search Edition instance. engine: OpenSearch Retrieval Engine Edition instance.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun searchengine list-instances --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ha-cn-pl32rf00000 --description searchengine_instance --resource-group-id rg-aekzgpiswzbksdi --edition vector --tags value=opensearch key=opensearch --catalog example-string --database example-string --table example-string --data-source-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
